source_text:
3.3 Ἀφρικανοῦ· περὶ γενέσεως ἵππων Ἂν μὲν
οὖν ἄρρεν τεχθῆναι θέλῃς, πρὸς τὴν ἀνατολὴν τοὺς ἵππους τρέπε, ἵνα μιγνύμενοι
βλέπωσι τὸν ἥλιον· αἱ δυσμαὶ γὰρ τίκτουσι τὰ θήλεα, ὡς Μαυρούσιος ὁ ἱπποφορβὸς
διηγήσατο. Καὶ γάρ, ὡς ὁ πάντων λόγος, τοὺς ἄρρενας ἵππους τῷ Ἡλίῳ ζεύγνυσθαι
καὶ τούτοις ἄγεσθαι τὴν φλόγα πεπίστευται, τὰς δὲ θηλείας τὴν Νύκτα ἄγειν φασί. Καὶ δικαίως μέν· ἀρρενοποιὸς μὲν ὁ Ἥλιος, ὁμωνύμου δὲ φύσεως ἡ Σελήνη τυγχάνει
μήτηρ.
pass_a_gloss: 3.3 Of-Africanus: concerning of-generation of-horses. If on-the-one-hand then a-male to-be-born you-want, toward the east the horses turn, in-order-that mating they-may-look-at the sun; the settings for they-bear the females, as Mauretanian the horse-herder related. And for, as the of-all account, the male horses to-the Sun to-be-yoked and by-these to-be-driven the flame it-is-believed, the but females the Night to-drive they-say. And justly on-the-one-hand: male-making on-the-one-hand the Sun, of-like-named but nature the Moon happens mother.
pass_b_english: Of Africanus: on the generation of horses. If then you want a male to be born, turn the horses toward the east, so that as they mate they look at the sun; for the west produces the females, as the Mauretanian horse-herder related.

For also, as the account of all has it, it is believed that the male horses are yoked to the Sun and that the flame is driven by them, and they say that the females drive the Night. And justly: the Sun is male-making, and the Moon happens to be mother of a like-named nature.

choices.english: as they mate they look at the sun
choices.why: The horses couple facing east so they see the sun. Not 'mix with the sun'.

choices.term: τὰς δὲ θηλείας τὴν Νύκτα ἄγειν φασί
choices.english: they say that the females drive the Night
choices.why: The mares drive Night, as the stallions drive the Sun's flame. CF crib made them led by the moon.
rejected: the females are led by the moon
the females lead at night as a time of day

choices.why: Same ethnonym as 2.12 Μαυρούσιοι. A named informant is possible, but the lock is the adjective with the office.
rejected: Maurousios as a unique personal name forced
Moorish breeder as a later ethnonym

choices.term: ὁμωνύμου δὲ φύσεως ἡ Σελήνη τυγχάνει μήτηρ
choices.english: the Moon happens to be mother of a like-named nature
choices.why: Selene is mother of female nature, sharing the name/gender. Not 'of the same nature' with μήτηρ stranded.
rejected: the moon happens to be of the same nature / mother
the moon is a mother only

anf_compare.notes: No PD English of the Cesti body; ANF has the letters only.
